body: hi avicus networks admins and staff, my account got banned on avicus due to hacking 2years ago and it the ban still hasnt been lifted yet i would like to appeal to unban my account on avicus network as i am deeply regretful for hacking 2 years back and i promise not to do it again.

title: Please Unban me

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Hey illusive,

Normally I'd direct unban you in this situation, however, as you have since a few days ago played on FlappyPancake this will stay as follows:

• Due to the fact that you haven't ban evaded in two years this ban will be reduced to a 20-day ban.

• The account that you used to ban evade of your friend (return it to him please) will have a 20-day ban so as to the end of the ban reduction ban.

Regards,
Javi
